summary: CourseDocument manages course-related documents, including their metadata, storage, retrieval, addition, and deletion operations. It interacts with the database via stored procedures and maintains links between courses, documents, and users/agencies.
purpose: To provide a structured method for handling course documents: storing document files and their metadata, allowing users to add and remove documents, validating document requirements (e.g., type code), linking documents to courses and users/agencies, and formatting document details for presentation and notification.

workflows.name: Add Course Document
steps: Prepare parameters (SessionID, CourseDocumentID, CourseID, TypeCodeID, DocumentName, TypeComments, FileURL, FilePath, FileSize, FileType)
Execute query to add document data

workflows.name: Delete Course Document
steps: Retrieve document by ID using GetByID
Ignore any exceptions during file/folder deletion
Call stored procedure 'CourseDocumentDelete' to remove DB record

workflows.name: Retrieve Documents by Course ID
steps: Fill list with results using FillList method

workflows.name: Retrieve Documents by Document ID
steps: Fill list with results using FillList method

business_rules: TypeCodeID must be specified when adding a document (validation failure triggers error message: Document_Type_Required).
If document code is 'OTHER', display TypeCode as 'Other'.
If document Email is blank, EmailFormatted is an empty string.
FileURL is converted to a hyperlink if file exists; otherwise, 'Document_Not_Found' message is shown.
validations: TypeCodeID must be non-zero for Add operation.
File existence is checked before hyperlink is generated for FileURL.
Email is checked for non-empty before formatting.
calculations: FileSize displayed in KB for link description.
AgencyUserFormatted concatenates ShortName and initials of FirstName, MiddleName, LastName.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted assembles full name (via NameFormatter) and agency, phone.
conditions: Language: Use alt-language fields if UseAltLanguageFields is true.
File: Show hyperlink only if file exists; otherwise, show not found message.
Email: Format only if not empty.
system_behavior: Ignores exceptions when deleting file or folder.
Fills list of CourseDocument objects from DB reader.
Formats dates, names, and emails for display.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for DB access and context.
exceptions: Deletion ignores any exceptions if file/folder cannot be deleted.
Validation exception shown when TypeCodeID is missing.
File not found exception handled with 'Document_Not_Found' message.
content_gaps: No information on user interface or front-end handling.
No explicit error handling strategy beyond ignoring exceptions.
No details on document storage configuration or file handling policies.
Does not specify notification or audit trail systems.
